report:
# Read of unit U1a2 (the-lane-collects-its-resolution), round 1

Subject: worktree diff against base 7df11b99b992341e0745e5a1d445ae0d27afec9a, SHA-256 18a843b9775b6fa930e207a997b3fd9729f8ae858179708f5b1e3383d9165699. The read diff, the round's worktree.diff and `git diff HEAD --full-index` in the prepared copy are byte-identical (same hash). Judged against the build brief's U1a section: A6 (the next step) and T2 rows (a), (c), (d), (e); the seam line gives U1a2 "the failure path and `collecting`; T2 (a), (c), (d), (e); counted 7, doubled 14".

## Material findings

None.

AGREE

## What was checked

Checklist item 1 (the diff against the brief):
- `collecting := false` is declared beside `result` (`cmd/metasystem/landing_merge.go:53`) and set to true only in the branch where the job is `Completed` and the fix `resolving` and `plain.CompleteMerge` runs (`:95`), as A6 requires.
- The failure path (`:240-249`) is the brief's A6 block verbatim: `landing resolve` with "returns the goal with its paths"; the same typed command with "collects this same job once the cause above is gone" when the fix is still `resolving` and `collecting`; `work review G --work U` with "repeats the read of the committed merge" when `resolved`. `next` and `nextReason` are now set together on every route of this path.
- Routing traced through `CompleteMerge`/`commitResolvedMerge` (`internal/landing/plain/resolve.go:594-706`): a red check, a moved HEAD, conflict markers and the named unstaged refusal all return with `fix.State` still `resolving`, so they name the same command; a `RefreshMerge` that returns or abandons the fix, and `mergeStateError`, leave a non-`resolving` state and name `landing resolve`; a job that ended without completing (`:92-93`) never sets `collecting` and names `landing resolve`. Errors before any collection (status read, launch) keep `landing resolve`, as the brief says. `CompleteMerge` has one production caller (`landing_merge.go:98`), so no sibling site needs the rule.
- Nothing outside the brief changed: two files, production 7 additions and 2 deletions (9 measured against the doubled 14); the test file's 172/104 is T2's new row table, mostly re-indentation of U1a1's coordination row, plus the `slices` import. `gofmt -l` prints nothing; `go vet ./cmd/metasystem` is clean.

Checklist item 2 (the proof command `/usr/bin/true` runs no tests, so the read ran them):
- `go test ./cmd/metasystem -run 'TestARefusedCollectionNamesTheSameCommand|TestLaneMergeBuildCollectsOneJobOnBatchTree' -count=1`: PASS (all five T2 rows and the six rows of the existing bed).
- Mutation, `landing resolve` for every error (the `collecting` override disabled): rows unstaged, check and markers fail, as the brief's T2 mutation requires.
- Mutation, the `collecting` guard dropped (`resolving` alone routes to the same command): the failed-job row fails.
- The base production file (U1a1) under the new test: unstaged, check and markers fail with `next` `landing resolve` and reason "collects this same job", which is the brief's "first failure on main"; the failed-job row fails on its reason.
- The rows assert exit code, summary text, exact `next` argv and exact reason, the commit count and an unmoved HEAD on every refusal; the check fake now also pins the check argv and directory.
- The worktree was restored from a scratch copy after each mutation; `git diff HEAD --full-index` hashes to the subject's SHA-256 afterwards.

## Non-gating observations

1. `cmd/metasystem/landing_merge.go:101-104` (success path, not changed by this unit): after a successful collection `next` becomes `work review G --work U` while `nextReason` keeps the initial "collects this same job". It is the same rule this unit applies to the failure path (`next` and `nextReason` set together), but the brief's A6 covers failures only, and the argv the agent follows is correct. A later unit could give it "reads the committed merge". RELATION: new
2. `internal/landing/plain/resolve.go:699-701` with `landing_merge.go:240-248` (pre-existing): if `WriteFix` fails after the merge commit, `fix.State` is `reviewing` in memory and the failure path names `landing resolve` with "returns the goal with its paths" although the merge is committed. Before this unit the same argv was named; A6's table covers `resolved` only. Rare and outside U1a2's brief. RELATION: new
3. T2 has no moved-HEAD row (`resolve.go`, "the merge changed during its check"); the brief's T2 does not list one, and that error takes the same `collecting` route the three tested refusals pin. The check row's summary assertion is only "exit status 1". RELATION: new

## Budget

Every checklist item was checked within the tool-call budget (13 of 48 calls).

VERDICT: land
